cohort: Mothers (n=1,287) who delivered a single live-born infant at Kokura Medical Center in Japan during 2018-2019.
finding: Maternal aging (>=35 years) and infant anomaly were identified as risk factors for PPD, with PPD occurring in mothers with worsened EPDS scores after mental care.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an initial risk factor for PPD but was associated with improved EPDS scores in multivariate analysis.
